verdict.rationale: Airbyte exposes an API and Terraform provider that let users programmatically create/manage many connections/syncs as code, and PyAirbyte lets developers extract data from many sources in scripts — all of which support bulk, automation-driven workflows. However, there is no explicit documentation of a genuine bulk/batch operation primitive (e.g., a single call to trigger, pause, or reconfigure many connections/streams at once), so support is inferred rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or CLI commands for operating on many connections/streams simultaneously, and any hands-on/independent evidence of doing so at scale.
